title: Spark 1.3 and spark.js
excerpt: I’m excited to announce the release of Spark 1.3 and the launch of spark.js, our new JavaScript API for real-time GPU texture compression on the web. The highlight of this release is full WebGPU support. Spark’s real-time codecs are now available as WGSL compute shaders that run natively in modern browsers. To make it easy…
